description: This file implements the GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient class, which manages audio playback using GStreamer, including opening, closing, playing, pausing, setting end-of-stream, handling new audio samples, and managing backend communication and state notifications.

classes.name: GStreamerWebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: A class that manages WebAudio playback via GStreamer, handling backend communication, buffer management, and state notifications.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes the audio stream based on provided GstCaps, parsing format, rate, channels, and configuring backend.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the audio stream and releases resources.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the backend.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the audio stream is open.

methods.name: notifyPushSamplesTimerExpired
methods.description: Callback invoked when the push samples timer expires to process buffered samples.

methods.name: notifyNewSample
methods.description: Handles new GstBuffer sample, queues it for processing.

methods.name: pushSamples
methods.description: Processes buffered samples, writes them to the backend, manages leftover data, and handles end-of-stream.

methods.name: isNewConfig
methods.description: Determines if the current configuration differs from the previous one, requiring reinitialization.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Handles state change notifications and invokes corresponding callbacks.
